verdict.rationale: GitLab's own Git version control and merge-request review [gitlab-docs-7, gitlab-docs-1] can cover repo-file automation artifacts such as AGENTS.md instructions and MR review instructions [gitlab-docs-69, gitlab-docs-70]. Agent actions are also attributed in commit histories [gitlab-docs-62]. The evidence never documents versioning, review, or rollback for custom flows, custom agents, or CI/CD pipeline definitions themselves. missing for 10: explicit version history and rollback for Duo custom flows/agents, documentation that CI/CD automation config is versioned and revertable, independent corroboration.
